Listen to this article AI narration Playback position 0:00 1:36 10 10 Playback speed 1× Roads and Highways Minister, Governs Kwame Agbodza has expressed satisfaction with the progress of work on the Dambai Bridge project, saying the latest developments give him confidence that the project will be completed within the scheduled timeframe.
He urged the contractor to sustain the current pace of work and avoid further delays, stressing that the government was keen to see the project completed on time.
“We just don’t want to see any lapses anymore on this site. We are completely happy with what has happened so far on the Maripoma site at Dambai Bridge. Let us build upon this and make sure that we can complete on time,” he said during inspection of works on the project on Tuesday, November 10.
Agbodza noted that significant progress had been made since his previous visit, pointing out that some of the work observed during the latest inspection was not in place at the time.
“This wasn’t here when we were here the last time. This is significant progress. One per cent variance is not a problem to me; the extent of work done is what matters,” he added.
The Minister said the progress recorded so far suggests that the project is likely to meet its deadline, provided the contractor maintains the momentum.
